description.subtitle: Bayern Munich adidas anthem jacket 2026 2027 - red
description.tagline: Bayern's passion inside and outside the countryside
description.intro: The adidas anthem jacket from Bayern Munich is inspired by the club’s official equipment and designed to make you live football beyond the stadium. Its style combines the sport essence with an urban look that allows you to represent Bayern Munich at any time.
key_benefits: Official Bayern Style: Design inspired by the German club equipment.
Daily comfort: Light fabric ideal for long use.
Cierre completo: Cremallera frontal para mayor practicidad.
Versatile look: Perfect for leisure, stadium or daily use.
